name: Muster landing page presents the current beta and desktop guide

planSteps.description: Open https://muster.orazen.online/ in a fresh browser context and wait for the page to render. Do not sign in or start a download.
The hero heading reads Your next idea has company.
An Open Muster link points to /app and the Get the desktop app link points to /download.html.
The model cost note reads Free app. Your AI usage is separate. and explains that provider subscriptions, API usage, and connected services may have their own costs.

The page explains that users choose a supported model for each teammate and bring their provider connection. The Explore models & setup link points to /docs/engines, and the FAQ explains that a supported connection may use a provider login, subscription, API key, or configured local model.
Open the Get the desktop app link to /download.html as a documentation page. Do not click a release download button or start a download.

The download guide includes macOS, Windows and Linux guidance; record this as page content only, not proof that a browser installed a release artifact or verified its signing, notarization, launch, or upgrade.
